topics.description: Child care fraud is a growing concern in the US, with millions of dollars being lost to fraudulent activities. The recent investigation in Minnesota has brought attention to this issue, and it is likely that more cases will be uncovered in the coming months.
ICE has been involved in several controversies in recent months, including the shooting of Silverio Villegas-Gonzalez. This has led to increased scrutiny of the agency and its activities.
